source.title: On the Petrials of thin rank 3 geometries

scope: Source-bound proposed principal-result reduction and exact auxiliary-claim ledger. Independent review is separate; no public registry promotion or priority claim.

numbered_statements.exact_target: Thin regular residually connected rank-three geometry with thin regular Petrial has linear diagram.
numbered_statements.adapter: Theorem A proves |ab|=2 or |ac|=2 from thinness of the Petrial alone; both possible geometric face-stabilizer branches are treated.
retained_inputs: Elementary group actions and dihedral normal form

numbered_statements.exact_target: For an ordinary map, the chamber-defined walk is its conventional Petrie walk.
numbered_statements.adapter: Section2 identifies the three successive panel changes with alternating corner changes; equal underlying vertex-edge sets are still identified.

numbered_statements.exact_target: The geometrically defined Petrial is residually connected.
numbered_statements.adapter: Walk connectivity of new face residues and path replacements in old vertex/edge residues; connected old vertex-edge truncation derived directly.

numbered_statements.exact_target: Unconditional embedding of original type-preserving automorphism group in that of its Petrial.
numbered_statements.adapter: Natural homomorphism exists with kernel contained in <a>; K_(2,2,2) gives original group C2^3 and Petrial group C2^2.
numbered_statements.remaining_obligation: No claim about historical priority of this explicit boundary.

numbered_statements.exact_target: For a thin Petrial, applying the Petrial twice recovers the original geometry.
numbered_statements.adapter: After the principal obstruction, vertex-edge interchange reduces to [a,c]=1; the new marking is (a,b,ca), the second shift cb, and old face shadows are proved distinct.

numbered_statements.exact_target: The original and thin-Petrial automorphism groups agree via their retained-object action.
numbered_statements.adapter: Face-residue transitivity gives regularity of the induced action; its panel action forces a outside the kernel and hence faithfulness.

other_scope_records.adapter: K_(2,2,2) has linear diagram but its Petrial has one face and is nonthin. Earlier atlas examples are not reproduced.
C2 times S3 has chamber step order6 but only3 vertices and3 edges in its Petrie set; uniform proofs do not require the equality.
The separate bounded access audit obtained no body; no theorem reduction or principal credit is proposed.

method: Panel stabilizer action on two completions
Changed marking after faithfulness and linearity are proved
retained_inputs: Conventional map/Petrie-walk definition; no external map classification

finite_evidence.scope: Seven explicit finite examples; no exhaustion or uniform proof claim.
checks: All original and Petrial incidence flags and connected rank-two residues
Geometric chamber-flip Petrial with set deduplication
All four thin-case induced chamber orbits and bidual face shadows
does_not_claim: Independent uniform proof from finite examples

remaining_work: External peer review and bounded priority follow-up remain separate. No source-defect priority claim.
